## scripts/dropt_loose_materials.zs (SHA-256 98d998ff8afb800c22a746914fa4d3712b8da80a28d30996f3d2545e9b3cd849)
1: import mods.dropt.Dropt;
2: 
3: // piles & rocks
4: Dropt.list("pile_dirt")
5: 
6:   .add(Dropt.rule()
7:       .matchBlocks(["growthcraft_rice:ricepaddy", "minecraft:dirt", "minecraft:grass", "minecraft:mycelium", "minecraft:dirt:1", "minecraft:dirt:2", "minecraft:farmland", "minecraft:grass_path", "betterwithmods:fertile_farmland", "pyrotech:farmland_mulched"])
8: 	  .matchHarvester(Dropt.harvester()
9:           .type("PLAYER")
10: 		  .mainHand("BLACKLIST", [], "shovel;1;-1")
11: 	  )
12:   	  .addDrop(Dropt.drop()
13:           .selector(Dropt.weight(1))
14:        	   .items([<betterwithmods:dirt_pile>], Dropt.range(4))
15:       )
16:   );

## scripts/minecraft_(max-file-size).zs (SHA-256 f4ab55e3a588fb0cf31a29afa04b0efb8bdc6e108e0c990d246d0d97eb7e0ffa)
216: // rocks/piles to cobble/blocks and viceversa 
217: var ctr as IItemStack[IItemStack] = {
218:   <minecraft:dirt> : <betterwithmods:dirt_pile>,
267: for cobble, rock in ctr {
268:   recipes.addShapeless(cobble, [rock,rock,rock,rock]);
269:   recipes.addShapeless(rock*4, [cobble]);
270: }

## config/betterwithmods.cfg (SHA-256 852aa1942448d0c53bf425a2b3b8bfa33eff01d9cef4c2f2254dd6734648e3e3)
494:     # Makes soils drop 75% of their content if not broken with a shovel to incentivize the use of shovels
495:     B:HCPiles=false
